page.overview:
What is Lacewing fly?

Lacewing flies, or just lacewings, are small green insects named for their large, transparent, laced wings. Lacewing flies were sold at the Magical Menagerie. Lacewing flies were an ingredient used in the Polyjuice Potion, where they must be stewed for twenty-one days. Lacewing flies were not on the Restricted Register.

In late 1992, Hermione Granger stewed some lacewing flies in order to brew the Polyjuice Potion in her second year.
